ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java // r16: partners left out of the report (PROD: BND, our test tenant, whose test labels go to the test endpoint) var hide = ((p('labelSweep.reportHidePartners') default "") splitBy ",") map trim($) filter ($ != "") var rows = (vars.reportCounts default []) filter !(hide contains ($.provider_code as String)) fun total(list) = sum(list map (($.n default 0) as Number)) default 0 var codes = ((rows filter ($.provider_code != "-")) map ($.provider_code as String)) distinctBy $ orderBy $ var partners = codes map ((code) -> do { var mine = rows filter ($.provider_code == code) --- { partner: code, byWebhook: total(mine filter (($.status == "sent") and ($.source == "webhook"))), bySweep: total(mine filter (($.status == "sent") and ($.source != "webhook"))), wouldSend: total(mine filter ($.status == "dry_run")), failing: total(mine filter (["failed", "sending"] contains $.status)), rejected: total(mine filter ($.status == "rejected")), noUrl: total(mine filter ($.status == "no_webhook_url")) } }) --- { dryRun: p('labelSweep.dryRun') == 'true', partners: partners, byWebhook: sum(partners map $.byWebhook) default 0, bySweep: sum(partners map $.bySweep) default 0, wouldSend: sum(partners map $.wouldSend) default 0, failing: sum(partners map $.failing) default 0, rejected: sum(partners map $.rejected) default 0, otherLabels: total(rows filter (($.provider_code == "-") and ($.status == "not_partner"))), noFills: total(rows filter ($.status == "no_fills")), lookupFailed: total(rows filter ($.status == "lookup_failed")), notDelivered: ((vars.reportOpen default []) filter !(hide contains ($.provider_code as String))) map { label: $.label_id, partner: $.provider_code, status: $.status, attempts: $.attempts, since: $.created_epoch, error: $.last_error } }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var r = vars.labelReport fun s(v) = if (v == null) "" else (v as String) fun esc(v) = ((s(v) replace "&" with "&") replace "<" with "<") replace ">" with ">" fun ct(epoch) = if (epoch == null) "" else ((((epoch as Number) as DateTime {unit: "seconds"}) >> "America/Chicago") as String {format: "MMM d, h:mm a"}) var cell = "style='padding:4px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;text-align:left'" fun row(values) = "" ++ ((values map ("" ++ esc($) ++ "")) joinBy "") ++ "" fun head(values) = "" ++ ((values map ("" ++ $ ++ "")) joinBy "") ++ "" var delivered = r.byWebhook + r.bySweep var open = r.failing + r.rejected var subject = s(p('labelSweep.reportSubjectPrefix')) ++ "Shipping labels, last 24 hours: " ++ s(delivered) ++ " delivered" ++ (if (open > 0) ", " ++ s(open) ++ " not delivered" else "") ++ (if (r.dryRun) " (sweep in dry run, " ++ s(r.wouldSend) ++ " it would send)" else "") var partnerTable = if (isEmpty(r.partners)) "

No partner labels in the last 24 hours.

" else "" ++ head(["Partner", "Sent by DRX's webhook", "Sent by the sweep", (if (r.dryRun) "Sweep would send" else ""), "Failing", "Rejected by partner"] filter ($ != "")) ++ ((r.partners map row([$.partner, $.byWebhook, $.bySweep] ++ (if (r.dryRun) [$.wouldSend] else []) ++ [$.failing, $.rejected])) joinBy "") ++ "
" var openTable = if (isEmpty(r.notDelivered)) "

Nothing is waiting: every partner label from the last 3 days was delivered.

" else "

Not delivered (last 3 days):

" ++ head(["DRX label", "Partner", "Status", "Tries", "First seen (Central)", "Last error"]) ++ ((r.notDelivered map row([$.label, $.partner, $.status, $.attempts, ct($.since), $.error])) joinBy "") ++ "
" var content = "" ++ "

Partner shipping labels in the last 24 hours" ++ (if (r.dryRun) " (the sweep is in dry run: it records what it would send and sends nothing)" else "") ++ ":

" ++ "
  • " ++ s(delivered) ++ " delivered: " ++ s(r.byWebhook) ++ " by DRX's webhook, " ++ s(r.bySweep) ++ " by the sweep
    • " ++ (if (r.dryRun) "
  • " ++ s(r.wouldSend) ++ " the sweep would have sent (DRX's webhook never fired for them)
    • " else "") ++ "
  • " ++ s(r.failing) ++ " failing (retried every " ++ s(p('labelSweep.retryMinutes')) ++ " minutes), " ++ s(r.rejected) ++ " rejected by the partner
    • " ++ "
  • " ++ s(r.otherLabels) ++ " other labels checked (not a partner order), " ++ s(r.noFills) ++ " with no fills, " ++ s(r.lookupFailed) ++ " that could not be read from DRX
" ++ partnerTable ++ openTable ++ "

From the MuleSoft provider API label sweep. Counts and DRX label ids only.

" --- { message: { subject: subject, body: { contentType: "HTML", content: content }, toRecipients: (s(p('labelSweep.reportTo')) splitBy ",") map { emailAddress: { address: trim($) } } }, saveToSentItems: true }
